issue.title: デモアカウントの用意

summary: Create separate deterministic synthetic demo fixtures and a reversible staging demonstration workspace/account procedure.
decisions: The automated E2E fixture workspace is separate from the human demonstration Google Ads account.
Fixtures contain synthetic data only and are resettable.
A real demonstration account is an external staging prerequisite, not committed test data.
requirementRefs: REQUIREMENTS.md#11-セキュリティと受け入れ

risks.description: A demo fixture could include customer or credential data.
risks.mitigation: Use generated identifiers and scan fixtures/evidence for secrets and real customer data.

risks.description: A previously modified demo workspace may not reproduce the intended flow.
risks.mitigation: Provide an idempotent reset and assert stable fixture counts and states.

gates.description: Provide or approve a non-production Google Ads client account and reversible test campaign.

acceptanceCriteria: One command resets the local E2E workspace to documented stable states.
Fixtures contain no real customer, credential, or token data.
The fixture covers onboarding, active dashboard, partial/error data, setup, conversation, report, and write-review states.
The staging runbook identifies safe targets, approval, reset, and cleanup.

rollback.strategy: Reset or delete only the explicitly identified synthetic workspace; restore the approved staging campaign through Issue #1 controls.
rollback.verification: Re-run reset and confirm deterministic state plus zero remaining staging mutations.
